proposed_english: to be in the likeness of
rationale: Lyc. verb structuring the body-cosmos correspondence series in this kephalaion (lines 5, 9, 13, 14, 15). Functions as parallel to ⲧⲛ̄ⲧⲁⲛⲧ̄ 'be likened.' Possibly related to ⲱⲡ 'count, reckon' (= 'be reckoned-as-like') or to a separate likeness-stem. Preserves the correspondential identification: 'X is in the likeness of Y' as direct cosmic mapping rather than mere comparison.
Lyc. ⲣ̄- + ⲍⲙ̄ⲙⲉ (= Sah. ϩⲙⲙⲉ 'steer'). Used reflexively in line 6: 'steer himself toward the Good.' Standard nautical-moral verb.

Orthographic variant of ⲡⲫⲉⲣⲣⲟⲕⲁⲧⲟⲭⲟⲥ (in glossary). Greek φερρόκατοχος < φέρω + κατέχω 'bear and hold-down.' Cosmic Holder standing above the Zone — here corresponding to the throat/neck register of the body-cosmos schema.

Greek loanword στόμαχος 'stomach.' Cosmic correspondent of the body's stomach (line 13-14): the cosmic Stomach IS Hyle / the digestive-fire region, and the elect lord over the stomach's fire as Adamas of Light lords over Hyle. Direct anatomical-cosmological correspondence.

Untranslated/transliterated. Possibly a Coptic doublet on ϥⲓ/ⲃⲓ 'bear, lift' yielding 'bearer-of-foot, bearer-(of-load)' as paired epithets of the Omophoros at the body's lowest cosmic register. Alternative: Semitic loan (Aramaic bīrā 'fortress'). Confidence low; flagged for parallel attestations in subsequent kephalaia.
Body-anatomy term from Coptic ⲧⲏⲡⲥⲉ/ⲧⲉⲡⲥ 'heel, sole' with possessive prefix. Mapped to ⲡⲛⲟⲩⲛ ⲉⲧⲙⲡⲓⲧⲛⲉ 'the Deep below' as the cosmic terminus of the body-correspondence schema.

Standard Manichaean cosmological 'Protomē/Foremost-Image' (in glossary) here as cosmic correspondent of the head — the body's face above the body IS in the likeness of the cosmic Protomē above the cosmos. Direct facial-cosmological correspondence.

Manichaean technical term for the sun-ship and moon-ship together — the two cosmic luminaries (cf. accumulated ⲛⲉⲭⲏⲩ 'the ships,' ⲡⲭⲁⲓ̈ ⲙⲫⲟⲟⲩⲉ 'ship of the day,' ⲡⲭⲁⲓ̈ ⲛⲧⲟⲩⲱⲏ 'ship of the night'). Here the four cardinal virtues (love, joy, faith, truth) ARE in the likeness of the two ships, since the living soul ascends through them as light ascends through the luminaries.
